title: Fix highlight misalignment when zooming
description:
Zooming the PDF Viewer could briefly (or stuck) drift highlight lines off the sheet. Root cause: page width/height changed on zoom, then highlight math rewrote position fractions from the old pixel coords against the new size. Zooming again sometimes realigned them by accident.

PipeSync now locks highlight positions before any zoom resize, then rematerializes only from the stored fractions — same safe pattern structure nodes already used. Page height also prefers the known PDF aspect so overlays paint correctly on the first zoom tick.

Who is affected: PipeSync PDF Viewer (continuous) on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh, draw or auto-highlight a line, then Ctrl+wheel zoom in/out repeatedly — highlights should stay glued to the sheet.
changeLog: Lock highlight nrx/nry before Viewer zoom changes page size.
Heal highlights from fractions only (never rewrite fractions after resize).
Use known PDF aspect for page height so first overlay paint matches the sheet.
Apply the same lock→resize→heal pattern on mount and aspect corrections.
